channel.title: Spatial Omics Radar
channel.description: New technologies, tools, AI models and benchmarks across spatial omics

item.title: Weekly update · 41 new entries
item.description: VirTues stands out this week as a foundation model in Nature for multiplex spatial proteomics—rare venue weight against a sea of preprints. Foundation models are a clear sub-theme (TissueFormer, PENNE), and DeepHis2Exp's six-dataset benchmark adds rigor. Multi-omics integration (FOCUS, CHIMERA) and a metabolomics MALDI assay hitting 500nm resolution round out cross-modality coverage.
